uniques.name: Widow's Wick
uniques.text: +1 light radius; enemies within your light take +10% damage.
uniques.lore: She kept the wick trimmed for a husband who never walked home.

uniques.name: Ninefold Shroud
uniques.text: Holds 9 charges, each absorbing one hit entirely; recharges 1 every 20 turns.
uniques.lore: Nine anchoresses stitched it by a single candle, and each sewed one prayer into the hem.

uniques.name: The Margrave's Signet
uniques.text: 3% of all damage you deal heals you; -20% max Life.
uniques.lore: The margrave pressed it into the wax of every death warrant he signed.

uniques.name: Bellwright's Gauntlets
uniques.text: Every 4th attack stuns the enemies next to you for 1 turn.
uniques.lore: Beaten from the cracked tenor bell of a drowned chapel; the iron still hums when it strikes.

uniques.name: Lanternjaw
uniques.text: +3 light radius; unholy enemies within your light are Slowed.
uniques.lore: A lamp burns behind the visor where a face should be, and the dead turn from it.
